cases.title: invoke ammunition
cases.mission: Ranger invokes blessed Longbow of Diana
cases.selectionRationale: Frozen source/state/action candidate before JS comparison. C-only inventory/pager/command-route corrections were read from independent C output/source; no recipe was changed to exploit a JS failure. Initial outcomes are retained when substantively distinct, otherwise documented outside the manifest.
cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step46 g invokes Longbow of Diana. C artifact.c1934-1961 generates15 arrows, normalizes blessing/erosion/weight and calls hold_another_object, whose invent.c1208-1310 tail calls encumber_msg after prinv/update_inventory. JS artifacts.js2514 passes state without the required acquisition encumberMessage operation; invent.js4857 refuses after creating/adding arrows. The missing frame, rather than later monster RNG, is first.

cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step23 space acknowledges special level materialization. C hack.c3626-3740 resolves svr.rooms[roomno], gives peaceful Oracle welcome and sets the same room rtype OROOM. JS rooms.js379 writes state.level.rooms[roomIndex].rtype after greeting, but the conceptual C room index can be a persisted subroom; dungeon.js:mapseen_room resolves the parent graph for reading while the write still indexes top-level rooms directly. TypeError omits the boundary. Source room identity, not welcome text, is the first divergence.

cases.title: nymph wielded goblin combat
cases.mission: Polymorph to wood nymph and melee armed goblin
cases.selectionRationale: Frozen source/state/action candidate before JS comparison. C-only inventory/pager/command-route corrections were read from independent C output/source; no recipe was changed to exploit a JS failure. Initial outcomes are retained when substantively distinct, otherwise documented outside the manifest.
cases.sourceTrace: Segment0 step85 space acknowledges barehand onset before nymph miss. C uhitm.c:missum5198-5214 tests could_seduce(youmonst,mdef,mattk) and prints pretend to be friendly. JS uhitm.js7202-7228 omits that test under a comment assuming Upolyd is false, although hmonas calls it while wood nymph. Column4 differs pretend vs miss; RNG matches. Armed-nymph goblin variation shares this first cause, not a separate theft qualification.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Invoked artifact generates ammunition and admits it through inventory acquisition
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: Segment0 step46 g invokes Longbow of Diana. C artifact.c1934-1961 generates15 arrows, normalizes blessing/erosion/weight and calls hold_another_object, whose invent.c1208-1310 tail calls encumber_msg after prinv/update_inventory. JS artifacts.js2514 passes state without the required acquisition encumberMessage operation; invent.js4857 refuses after creating/adding arrows. The missing frame, rather than later monster RNG, is first.
qualifyingSessions.wholeSourceScope: Bounded artifact.c:invoke_create_ammo acquisition environment wiring to canonical invent.c:hold_another_object; verify generated arrow identity and all acquisition operations.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Healing invocation emits both source better messages for temporary blindness
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: Segment0 step87 k invokes Staff after a blindness potion. C artifact.c1780-1816 has two independent You_feel conditions, yielding You feel better.  You feel better. JS artifacts.js2366 implements only the second condition/message. RNG and all cursors match; column18 misses the second Y.
qualifyingSessions.wholeSourceScope: Whole artifact.c:invoke_healing branch/message verification plus existing invocation caller; preserve both independent conditions and blindness clearing.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Transform a potion with a nonpotion catalyst and offer to name its unknown former appearance
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: Segment0 step44 f transforms booze via amethyst, printing emerald potion turns purple-red. C potion.c2774-2780 copies cg.zeroobj into fakeobj and calls docall with former potion type. JS potion.js3690 dereferences nonexistent state.cg.zeroobj, throwing before the naming frame. gstate stores canonical zeroobj elsewhere. Unicorn-horn sickness transformation reaches the identical first failure and counts once.
qualifyingSessions.wholeSourceScope: Bounded potion.c:potion_dip fake-object canonical state reconciliation; preserve former potion dknown/type/class and docall order. Whole mixtype/dip family remains separate.
